headline: Texas Instruments battery-charging role calls for RNM models, analog checkers and mixed-signal regressions
fact: A Texas Instruments Battery Charging Products job posting describes AMS verification of battery-management ICs. Its responsibilities include Verilog-A/AMS and wreal RNM behavioral models for top-level simulation, testbenches combining schematics, models and RTL, analog checks during simulation and after processing, RTL and gate-level regressions, and functional coverage through tape-out. UVM, scripting and interest in AI-based verification automation are preferred qualifications. A preserved copy identifies Santa Clara requisition 25018210 and a September 25, 2026 posting timestamp.
